facts.fact: liability 内幕：Fragon 暗示偏袒——她自曝「选累赘的是父亲 Lord Theron、给女儿挑了唯一顺手的」；Andilyn 介绍（「our Wild One…the beating heart of us and the worst of us when she's bored」）；Evelyn 骑术好但公主做派可能不够勇
facts.anchor: chose the only favorable one for his daughter

facts.fact: 空地遇袭：Peltin 发现死马→卫兵 Corbin（Alden 的人）尸体、红羽箭；另一匹倒地马=Evelyn 的（非 Mallet）；Draymor 肋部两箭还活着（「We were ambushed…They got Corbin and Kipp. They died right off their mounts」）——「Dranderons are here!」/「This isn't even enemy territory. What the fuck?」
facts.anchor: “It’s Corbin,” I say, choking back a sob.

facts.fact: Draven 的石头：棕石掷地——土墙轰然拔起挡住北面视线——Terrabastion Stone！「Stones. Of course Draven has rare stones.」（呼应 ch07 童年马车前弹出的土墙——那次也是他？）
Draymor 的情报：倒的马是 Evelyn 的——「Alden's got her…got both of them on Mallet」；她剥掉 Icarus 的选择权（「他一定会破令追我」）独自追 Alden
Alden 的状态：从树上放冷箭的懦夫——他被迫弃队带公主逃；「I had to leave them」的愧疚；「Draymor is alive!」的消息让他短暂松了一秒
facts.anchor: “They shot them! The fucking cowards came out of the trees.”

facts.fact: 换马计划：她把 Evelyn 半空拉上 Jaco、给公主挂盾护左；Mallet 双人骑撑不住——她命令公主接管 Jaco（「You. Will. Take. The. Fucking. Reins.」）+「He won't forgive me for leaving you」/「Eventually, he will」
facts.anchor: You. Will. Take. The. Fucking. Reins. You will get back

facts.fact: 跳马：她在疾驰中跃下（与童年遇袭时同样的翻滚）——「I love you, Jaco」——这次肘部撞石、手臂断裂；强撑起身骗他们「我没事」；「They do not stop. Alden put up less fight than I expected.」
